sg_law_available_law_mass_conscription = {
	NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_mass_conscription }
	NOT = { enacting_any_law = yes }
	"enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_mass_conscription)" >= define:NPolitics|LAW_MIN_SUCCESS_CHANCE
	NOT = {
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_strict_edo_system
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_intermediate_edo_system
		}
	}
	has_technology_researched = enlistment_offices
}

	NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation }
	NOT = { enacting_any_law = yes }
	"enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation)" >= define:NPolitics|LAW_MIN_SUCCESS_CHANCE
}

	NOT = { enacting_any_law = yes }

			NOT = {
				has_modifier = forced_market_opening
			}
			any_primary_culture = {
				has_discrimination_trait = heritage_han

			}

	}

sg_law_available_law_isolationism = {
	NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_isolationism }
	NOT = { enacting_any_law = yes }
	"enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_isolationism)" >= define:NPolitics|LAW_MIN_SUCCESS_CHANCE
			NOT = {
				has_modifier = forced_market_opening
			}
			NOR = {
				AND = {
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = heritage_han
					}
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = s:STATE_GUANGDONG
						is_largest_state_in_region = yes
					}
				}
				AND = {
					any_primary_culture = {
						cu:japanese = this
					}
					s:STATE_KYUSHU ?= {
						any_scope_state = {
							owner ?= ROOT
							is_largest_state_in_region = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
	NOT = {
		OR = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_laissez_faire
		}
	}
}
